title: elaphandra macrolepis
intro: Elaphandra macrolepis, commonly known as the Andean mint, is a plant species native to the Andes mountain range. It is valued for its leaves, which can be used to make a tea that has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Elaphandra macrolepis include its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it useful for alleviating symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome and other gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Elaphandra macrolepis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
